title: AI Code Review finding
description: One finding, as the reviewer keeps it internally and as stage 3 must return it. Every field maps to SARIF 2.1.0; the mapping is given in each description. A finding that does not validate is dropped and counted, never shown (decision D5).

rule_id.description: An id from rule-catalogue.yaml. SARIF result.ruleId. The model may not invent one.

stage.description: 2 for the deterministic gate, 3 for the quarantined review. SARIF run.tool.driver: the gate's tools and the reviewer's model are separate runs in one log.

cwe.description: SARIF result.taxa, referencing the CWE taxonomy. Required for model.security.* rules.

location.description: SARIF result.locations[0].physicalLocation. The file and lines must exist at the head commit (goal G2).

path.description: Repository-relative, or artifact-relative with the artifact named in 'artifact'.

artifact.description: For ingestion findings: the package URL (purl) of the artifact the path is inside.

evidence.description: What the finding rests on. At least one item. SARIF result.properties.evidence, and result.codeFlows where a path is shown.

ref.description: A path in the run's records, or a URL, that a reader can open.

quote.description: For quoted-span: the exact text at the location, checked by grounding.

tool.description: Name and version of the tool, for tool-output.

message.description: SARIF result.message.text. Plain, one or two sentences, no links to outside hosts (they are stripped before posting).

kind.description: SARIF result.kind. 'review' for a model finding no tool or test corroborates; 'fail' for a gate finding or a corroborated one.

blocking.description: Whether the team's policy holds the merge on this finding. Set by triage from the catalogue and the team's settings, never by the model.

confidence.description: Set by triage from the evidence (tool, corroboration, both passes agreeing), not from the model's self-report. SARIF result.rank, scaled 0 to 100.

passes.description: For stage 3: which passes produced it. A finding from one pass only, on a region the other judged differently, raises model.suspicious.pass-disagreement.

fingerprint.description: SARIF result.fingerprints['ai-code-review/v1'] and partialFingerprints.primaryLocationLineHash. Computed from rule id, normalized code and enclosing symbol, not the line number. Set by triage.

baseline_state.description: SARIF result.baselineState against the base commit's run. Only 'new' is posted as a comment.

test_request.description: For a claim only a test can settle: the request sent to the harness. The finding stays class 'unproven' until it answers.

suppression.description: SARIF result.suppressions[0]: a dismissal by a person, with the reason. Recorded, read by the gate, counted as answered by feedback.

by.description: The forge identity of the person who dismissed it.
